name: Grow Therapy Provider Platform
short_description: All-in-one provider network combining insurance credentialing, billing, documentation tools, and client referrals for therapists who want insurance work without administrative burden.
long_description: Grow Therapy is a comprehensive provider network designed to help mental health therapists build and scale insurance-based private practices. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in New York City, Grow Therapy has raised over $180 million in funding and serves thousands of therapists across all 50 states. Unlike platforms that only handle billing, Grow Therapy provides insurance credentialing, claims submission, basic documentation tools, scheduling, client matching, and a telehealth platform. The company is in-network with major insurance carriers including Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, Anthem, and various Blue Cross Blue Shield plans. Providers maintain independence as contractors while Grow Therapy eliminates the administrative complexity of insurance-based practice. Therapists typically see net session rates of $90-150+ depending on license type, location, and payer, with Grow Therapy taking a percentage fee (approximately 10-15%) from reimbursements. The platform's client matching system actively connects patients seeking therapy with available providers based on specialty, availability, and preferences. Note: While Grow Therapy includes basic documentation tools, most providers use a separate dedicated EHR for comprehensive clinical records.
one_liner: Free platform with 4.1/5 comp rating, $81/hr avg. 10-15% fee split. Solid middle-ground between Headway (free) and Alma ($125/mo).

faqs.q: How much do Grow Therapy therapists make per session?
faqs.a: Grow Therapy providers typically receive $90-150+ per session net after the platform fee. Actual rates depend on your license type, geographic location, insurance payer, and session codes. Payment is processed via weekly direct deposit. The platform fee covers credentialing, billing, EHR, and client referrals.

faqs.q: What does Grow Therapy include vs Headway?
faqs.a: Grow Therapy and Headway are similar provider networks that handle insurance credentialing, billing, and client referrals. Both provide basic documentation tools, but most therapists on either platform use a separate dedicated EHR for comprehensive clinical records.

faqs.q: How long does Grow Therapy credentialing take?
faqs.a: Insurance credentialing through Grow Therapy typically takes 4-8 weeks depending on the insurance panels and your state. Grow Therapy handles all paperwork and follow-up. You can use their telehealth platform immediately while waiting for insurance credentialing to complete.

faqs.q: Is Grow Therapy better than going independent?
faqs.a: Grow Therapy is ideal for therapists who want insurance-based income without administrative burden. The platform fee (10-15%) covers credentialing, billing, telehealth, and client referrals. Independent practice gives you higher per-session revenue but requires managing billing, credentialing, marketing, and software subscriptions yourself.
